p: Shmuel said to those who purchase branches of grapevines … turn over

Shmuel said to those who purchase branches of grapevines and pay in advance for the vine shoots that will be harvested later: Since the risk in this transaction is small, it has the appearance of interest and therefore you should turn over
the land … so that you acquire … the land itself for yourselves,
the land yourselves, i.e., perform some labor in farming the orchard, so that you acquire some of the land itself for yourselves,
it will be like a loan for you and
